facts.fact: Minister Avinash Ramtohul said the Cybersecurity and Cybercrime Act would be reviewed to address certain offences while strengthening protection of freedom of expression.

MUS.note: Covers an MoU between SIL and TCS; no national digital strategy is described.
Says only that more online services are in development and SIL is working with the land transport authority; no service launched or piloted is stated.
The planned Act review is not a repeal, and no cut, criticism or punishment is stated.
